items.title: Kimberly-Clark Backs Full-Year Growth Forecast Despite China Controversy
items.summary: The consumer-products company said organic growth in its international personal care segment declined 4.6% in the latest quarter while operating profit fell 33%, including a 17 percentage point drag from China.

items.title: Kimberly-Clark (NASDAQ:KMB) reports Q3 2026 in line with expectations
items.summary: Household products company Kimberly-Clark (NASDAQ:KMB) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, but revenue was flat year on year at $4.13 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.70 per share was 3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Kimberly-Clark beats estimates but shares slip on China headwinds
items.summary: Investing.com -- Kimberly-Clark Corporation (NASDAQ: KMB) reported third-quarter results that exceeded analyst expectations, though shares fell 1% as investors weighed headwinds from China market disruptions.
